additional_info.subject: ID0403060-DC/Si-D/NL[170001314] - AC socket is loose CRM:00315002315
additional_info.body:
Dear Monica,
In Netherlands, Equans customer, the AC socket is loose and needs to be checked.
It is required a FSE on site.
Charger ID:
jzZrXT; SN:170001314
Steps to troubleshoot:
From the photo, it seems that the HMI was replaced and the instructions were not fully performed, as I can see missing the sealing and my thought is that, when replacing this new HMI you need new screws that are longer due to a small gap created from the new HMI.
I send in attachment the instructions for the new HMI and it has included the MLFB codes for all the necessary parts.
From what I saw in the SCB, the charger and socket do not seem to be unoperational, so I believe there will not be necessary to replace this socket.
If you need any assistance please send this ticket back to eMobility DC Queue.

additional_info.subject: AC socket
additional_info.body:
F06-XD102 plug interlock is broken off AC plug.
The plug interlock is broken off the AC plug. The interlock pin cannot be moved in and placed back onto the AC plug.
8EM5903-0AA01-3AA4 needs to be replaced.
